common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one finished electric-scooter head-unit screen concept. EXACT image canvas 1280 x 768 pixels, landscape 5:3, edge-to-edge UI, no device frame, no brand marks, no perspective, no outside margins or title. Crisp readable typography and flat implementable vector geometry.
TOP HOST STRIP: exactly y=0 through y=47, a 48 px high thin very dark band, only 6.25% of total height. DO NOT enlarge this band. Nothing in it except exactly nine small scooter warning lights, left-to-right: left-turn arrow, right-turn arrow, high-beam icon, headlight icon, READY text, padlock icon, side-stand icon, fault icon, charging/battery-lightning icon; then a small solid yellow square hub button at far right. Compact lights about 20px tall centred vertically in strip. No numeric readouts, clock, headings, mode, separators, app nav, extra lights or labels in strip. Unlit lights are faint neutral outlines. Indicators and READY when lit are green; high beam blue; side stand amber; fault red; headlight, lock and charging when lit solid white. Strip must look identical in height and geometry in all concepts.
All theme content starts at y=48. Each fact displayed only once, with no repeated summary cards. Numerical scale labels allowed, but no duplicated telemetry values. Exact riding facts speed 42 km/h; mode Sport; battery 68 %; range 54 km; trip 12.4 km; odometer 3,218 km; clock 18:24; battery current 38 A at 52 V, power 2.0 kW; pack temperature 31 C; motor temperature 48 C. Parked exceptions: speed 0 km/h, mode P, Charging; other included facts unchanged. Zen only includes speed and battery, intentionally omit other facts.
No invented numbers, decorative fake text, gradients, bloom, glow, bevels, chrome, photorealistic reflections or dimensional objects. All graphics drawable in Slint with paths, strokes, arcs, text and sin/cos.

themes.twin:
Theme Twin Dial / Instrument. Deep blue-black #0B0E13 flat glass ground, very subtle depth. Precision condensed technical sans with tabular figures, crisp white text, engraved fine but visible scales and tick marks. One warm copper-orange accent #FF7A1A for needles and focus, clearly distinct from amber warning. Cool regen arc must be neutral slate-silver, not status blue or green. Solid surfaces and strong strokes for sunlight.
Large analog speedometer left half, range 0 to 120 km/h, major labels 0,20,40,60,80,100,120 in accurate order around calibrated arc. Huge digital speed centred inside. Power/regen dial right half, calibrated minus 3 kW to plus 6 kW, readable scale minus3,0,3,6, digital power 2.0 kW once inside. Two smaller inset dials between/below large dials: battery 68 % once and pack temp 31 C once; no redundant ticks labelled 68 or31. Small well-spaced support readouts for 38 A, 52 V, MOTOR 48 C, ODO 3,218 km. One slim bottom theme line with mode, RANGE 54 km, TRIP 12.4 km, clock 18:24, all readable. Keep content inside 720px tall theme body. No repeated header facts.
themes.terminal: Theme Terminal. Pure black body. Exactly one monospace font throughout, phosphor-green #33FF66 text and dim green labels; no other BODY colours. This explicit green theme law overrides shared status-colour exclusivity. No glow. Very faint horizontal scanlines only. System-monitor rows SPD, BAT, RNG, MODE, PWR, TEMP, TRIP, ODO, TIME with values right-aligned into fixed columns. ASCII block-character bar gauges for speed, battery and power. Hero speed is only speed readout, giant monospace digits about 190 px tall (quarter screen); unit km/h next to it, SPD label. BAT row 68 % with block gauge filled68%; RNG54km; MODE Sport or P; PWR2.0kW with 38A and52V once; TEMP PACK31C MOTOR48C; TRIP12.4km; ODO3,218km; TIME18:24. Do not duplicate digits in gauge endpoints. Smaller rows still large enough to read at glance. Bottom prompt line one block cursor only.
themes.zen: Theme Zen. Bright sunlight clarity: solid warm off-white #F4F1EA body, near-black #111111 ink. One quiet accent deep teal #0F6E6E ONLY for battery bar. Exactly TWO facts in body: speed and battery. Enormous centred near-black speed digits about 460px tall (60 percent of screen height), generous negative space, small km/h beside. Single thick horizontal battery gauge along bottom third, 68 percent filled in deep teal and remaining32percent neutral muted track, text "68 %" at its end, appearing once. No other text, labels, range, clock, power, mode, temperature, decoration, tick numbers or gradients. Generous margins, exact alignment. Top dark48px host strip remains thin; do not extend black header into cream content.
